title: Project Eleven Launches Strongpoint Post-Quantum Custody Platform with Zcash Foundation as Initial Development Partner - Quantum Computing Report
author: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
text:
Post-quantum digital asset security provider Project Eleven has introduced Strongpoint, an institutional custody platform engineered to provide a crypto-agile control layer as underlying blockchain networks transition to post-quantum cryptographic standards. The Zcash Foundation has joined as an initial development partner, contributing expertise in privacy-preserving cryptography, zero-knowledge proofs, and shielded key management to inform the platform’s institutional architecture.

Project Eleven’s analysis of the 20 largest Layer 1 (L1) blockchain networks by market capitalization reveals a fragmented migration landscape. Only 10 of these networks have published technical proposals, roadmaps, or implementation paths for post-quantum migration, spanning at least six distinct post-quantum signature schemes. Strongpoint addresses this coordination bottleneck by decoupling key management, transaction approval, and audit workflows from the underlying signature schemes, providing institutions with a crypto-agile control layer that adapts as networks update their cryptographic primitives.

Strongpoint is targeted for production deployment in Q4 2026. The platform’s commercial rollout builds upon Project Eleven’s $20 million Series A financing completed in January 2026 and its acquisition of Riva Labs in September 2026 to integrate post-quantum Multi-Party Computation (MPC) and automated cryptanalysis into its enterprise product suite.
